title: Primary Education Methods
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a teaching approach which enables the pupil to use his mental process to meditate, and or find out things for himself."
Discovery method is a teaching approach which enables the pupil to use his mental process to meditate, and or find out things for himself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of these concrete experiences that teacher can provide for the pupils to help them internalize learning."
Demonstration is one of these concrete experiences that teacher can provide for the pupils to help them internalize learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a pre-requisite for effective learning."
A conducive teaching/learning environment is a pre-requisite for effective learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act of going on sight-seeing usually done in a group and in a school system."
Field trip is an act of going on sight-seeing usually done in a group and in a school system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of ensuring that pupils are actively involved in learning using games."
Teachers should devise effective means of ensuring that pupils are actively involved in learning using games.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means an account of past events and incidents, invented or imagined."
Concept of Story-Telling Story means an account of past events and incidents, invented or imagined.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who, because of his rich experience or educational background in a given field is able to contribute to the growth and development of people who come in contact with him. (Good 1945)."

The teacher is a person who, because of his rich experience or educational background in a given field is able to contribute to the growth and development of people who come in contact with him. (Good 1945).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a predominantly interactive process involving a multiple - flow of communication between the teacher and the pupils and from one pupil to another."
Discussion approach is a predominantly interactive process involving a multiple - flow of communication between the teacher and the pupils and from one pupil to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a well planned programme whereby pupils are kept busy all the time on one assignment or the other."
The learning activity is a well planned programme whereby pupils are kept busy all the time on one assignment or the other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a problem especially in large classes or circumstances where extreme sharp objects are used. 5."
Visibility is a problem especially in large classes or circumstances where extreme sharp objects are used. 5.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the methods used by teachers to assist pupils attain certain educational objectives."
Questioning is one of the methods used by teachers to assist pupils attain certain educational objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an enjoyable activity which is related to growth."
Play is an enjoyable activity which is related to growth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a form of play but guided with rules."
Game can be defined as a form of play but guided with rules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the things we expect the pupils to do in the lesson; it is the interaction between the learner and his educative environment."
Learning activities are the things we expect the pupils to do in the lesson; it is the interaction between the learner and his educative environment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the approaches of teaching which involves purposeful learning activity that is usually based on interest and undertaken by an individual or small group."
Project method of teaching is one of the approaches of teaching which involves purposeful learning activity that is usually based on interest and undertaken by an individual or small group.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which information passes from the teacher to the pupils and vice versa during instruction."
Communication is the process by which information passes from the teacher to the pupils and vice versa during instruction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all techniques and efforts which the teacher puts in place to ensure that the pupils make the most of classroom interaction."
Classroom management refers to all techniques and efforts which the teacher puts in place to ensure that the pupils make the most of classroom interaction.
